_about: Travel notes for the Dungeons tab of Awesome House.
Routes are written from Classic-era geography and have NOT been checked in WoW: Forever yet.
To correct one: edit its steps and set "verified": true. A copy of this file next to AwesomeHouse.exe overrides the built-in one, dungeon by dungeon.
kind is "dungeon" or "raid" (leave empty if unknown). The key is the dungeon's area id; entrance coordinates come from QuestieDB, not from this file.

steps: The entrance is inside Orgrimmar, the Horde capital, so expect guards and players the whole way.
Enter Orgrimmar and head for the Cleft of Shadow; the portal is in the cave at the back.
Walk to the Cleft of Shadow inside Orgrimmar.
The portal is in the cave at the back of the Cleft.
Take the boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet if you don't have the flight point.
Ride west past the Crossroads road, then south-west to the oasis; the cave mouth is in the hillside above the water.
Follow the cave down to the portal.

Ride south to Moonbrook.
Enter the mine through the large building at the edge of town.
Follow the tunnels down, keeping to the main path, until you reach the portal.

steps: Ride north through Stranglethorn into Duskwood, then west into Westfall.
Head to Moonbrook in the south of Westfall and enter the mine through the large building at the edge of town.
Follow the tunnels down to the portal.
Ride west along the road into Silverpine Forest.
The keep stands on the hill above Pyrewood Village, just inside Silverpine; take the path up to the gate.

Ride south along the coast road into Ashenvale.

Ride west through Dustwallow Marsh into the Barrens, then south along the road.

1337.name: Uldaman

steps: Ride south from Loch Modan into the Badlands.
The front entrance is the dig site in the north-west of the Badlands; follow the excavation tunnels to the portal.
Ride east from Kargath.
The front entrance is the dig site in the north of the Badlands; follow the excavation tunnels to the portal.

1337.notes: There is a second, back entrance further east in the Badlands.

alliance.flight: Thorium Point (Searing Gorge) or Morgan's Vigil (Burning Steppes)
steps: From Thorium Point ride south-east to the Blackrock Mountain gate; from Morgan's Vigil ride west across the Burning Steppes.
Inside the mountain, follow the ledge to the central rock hanging on chains over the lava.
Blackrock Depths is at the bottom: go down from the central rock and through the quarry to the portal.

1583.name: Blackrock Spire

alliance.flight: Thorium Point (Searing Gorge) or Morgan's Vigil (Burning Steppes)
steps: From Thorium Point ride south-east to the Blackrock Mountain gate; from Morgan's Vigil ride west across the Burning Steppes.
Inside the mountain, follow the ledge to the central rock hanging on chains over the lava.
Blackrock Spire is at the top: cross from the central rock to the upper balcony and go up the ramp.

1583.notes: Lower and Upper Blackrock Spire share one entrance.

2557.name: Dire Maul

steps: Take the boat from the island to the mainland, then ride east along the road.
Dire Maul is the walled ruin in the middle of Feralas; each wing has its own door off the central courtyard.
Ride west along the road.
Dire Maul is the walled ruin in the middle of Feralas; each wing has its own door off the central courtyard.

2557.notes: Three wings: East, West and North.
